_comment: Njordlinger Combat Gameplay Overhaul - guild and faction routes by class (PLAN.md D30, GUILD-LOCKS.md; Q19 closed by the owner

adds ONE new response to each topic, placed first, with the topic's own speaker conditions plus 'the class lacks the group' and

every added response needs). The Dark Brotherhood route is the SKSE plugin's: DB02 is stopped as it starts for a class without
covert. Built after every other record so no form ID moves.
